summary: A single page tip calculator with three inputs and a per person result
assumptions: Amounts are shown with two decimals

ui_elements.label: Tip percent
ui_elements.purpose: Tip as a percent of the bill

ui_elements.label: Number of people
ui_elements.purpose: How many people share the bill

features.name: Bill inputs
features.description: Inputs for the bill amount, tip percent and number of people

acceptance_criteria.statement: All three inputs are visible and labelled

features.name: Per person result
features.description: Shows the bill plus tip divided by the number of people

acceptance_criteria.statement: 1000 with 10% tip split by 4 shows 275.00 per person
Zero people never shows NaN or Infinity

functions.name: calculatePerPerson
functions.description: Bill plus tip, divided by people
error_conditions: people is zero or less returns 0

visual_design: A single centered card on a light background, inputs stacked, result in large text.
